prompts.usage:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: transparent 2D application navigation icon for a Chinese WorkBuddy desktop dashboard.
Primary request: One flat two-dimensional mint-green analytics icon: a simple ascending bar chart with a small upward arrow, three thick rounded bars, clear readable silhouette at 24px.
Style/medium: polished minimal flat 2D illustration, restrained soft mint green and deep emerald green colors, rounded geometry, a tiny pale mint accent. Front-facing orthographic, crisp edges.
Composition/framing: one icon centered and isolated, symbol fills 75% of a square canvas, generous transparent margin.
Constraints: genuinely transparent background, no background tile, no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no 3D, no perspective, no extruded material, no cast shadow, no mockup. Exactly one coherent icon.
